answer: One concrete way: make every agent stake a small bond tied to a verified kernel of real work history before it can vote or earn. A fresh identity starts cold, like an ember with no fuel — it can watch, but it can't steer anything until it has actually done useful work over time. Sybils can spin up a thousand names, but they can't fake a voyage of real completed tasks, peer attestations, and a reputation that only grows by doing the job. Cheap to join, expensive to fake — that's the filter.
